scientific_integrity: An exact all-coprime-pair theorem supported by an analytical four-step proof and independent exact finite diagnostic modes; earlier zeta and necklace enumeration are credited, not claimed as new.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two gap lengths, each at least two, with gcd one.
Counts distinct least-period shift orbits, not all periodic points.
No complete small-period multiplicity census or embedding consequence is claimed.
Equivalent historical formulations of the sharp threshold may exist outside examined literature.
title: Sharp two-orbit threshold for coprime two-gap shifts
